description: This file serves as the entry point for a React application. It imports React, ReactDOM, CSS styles, and the main App component. It initializes the React root and renders the App component within React.StrictMode, which helps identify potential problems in an application.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a root for rendering a React application into the DOM.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders the React element into the root DOM node.
